slug: 2026-02-15 Digital - Benin outlines its strategic vision for 2031

facts.fact: A seminar on 5-6 February 2026, run by the Ministry of Digital and Digitalisation with Deloitte, drafted a digital strategic vision to 2031 spanning infrastructure, digitised public services, cybersecurity, local innovation, human capacity and enterprise financing, to end in a strategic reference document.
